school_name: The University of Texas at San Antonio
title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain The University of Texas at San Antonio
description: Ten currently documented food destinations on or near UTSA’s Main Campus, with late service or extended hours verified on direct official pages.

cards.entity_name: SU The Den at The Paseo
cards.title: The Den at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: UTSA Main Campus · Student Union
cards.notes: Use the Student Union location when studying late on campus; confirm the day’s schedule before heading over because the listed extended hours vary by day.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining counter with documented service until 2 a.m. on Sunday and Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Dining identifies SU The Den at The Paseo as a late-night campus dining option with doors open until 2 a.m. Sunday and Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: SU The Den at The Paseo
cards.access_notes: Official UTSA Dining listing says doors are open until 2 a.m. Sunday and Monday through Thursday.

cards.title: Fuego Tortilla Grill
cards.subtitle: 5618 UTSA Blvd · San Antonio
cards.notes: Choose the drive-thru for the late window and verify the weekday before leaving; the official listing distinguishes dining-room and drive-thru availability.
cards.short_summary: A UTSA Boulevard taco stop whose official listing documents a 24/6 drive-thru schedule Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Fuego’s official location page lists its San Antonio address at 5618 UTSA Blvd and drive-thru hours of 24/6 Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists San Antonio dining-room hours of 6 a.m.–10 p.m. Tuesday–Sunday and drive-thru hours of 24/6 Tuesday–Sunday.

cards.title: Chicken N Pickle
cards.subtitle: 5215 UTSA Boulevard · San Antonio
cards.notes: For a late meal near the boulevard, check Friday or Saturday availability and use the restaurant’s current location page before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A UTSA Boulevard restaurant with Friday and Saturday restaurant hours through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicken N Pickle’s San Antonio location page lists 5215 UTSA Boulevard and restaurant hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours Friday–Saturday, 8 a.m.–midnight; property hours are 7 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Whataburger at 1604 & La Cantera
cards.subtitle: 6803 N Loop 1604 W · San Antonio
cards.notes: Use either the dining room or drive-thru when you need an option beyond midnight; the location page marks both as available around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A nearby 24-hour Whataburger location at 1604 and La Cantera.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger’s official location page lists this 6803 N Loop 1604 W restaurant’s dine-in and drive-thru service as 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list dine-in and drive-thru as 24 hours every day; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Whataburger at De Zavala & I-10
cards.subtitle: 12808 W Interstate 10 · San Antonio
cards.notes: Treat this as an around-the-clock option by I-10; check the location page for any holiday exception before a very late trip.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Whataburger at the De Zavala and I-10 junction.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger’s official locator identifies the De Zavala & I-10 restaurant at 12808 W Interstate 10 as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists the location as open 24 hours; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Taco Bell on DeZavala
cards.subtitle: 4242 DeZavala Road · San Antonio
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru after the dining room closes, and plan around the later Thursday-through-Saturday schedule shown on the restaurant’s official page.
cards.short_summary: A DeZavala drive-thru with service listed until 2 a.m. most days and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 4242 DeZavala Road.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on N Loop 1604 W
cards.subtitle: 7323 N Loop 1604 W · San Antonio
cards.notes: This is the later Loop 1604 drive-thru option; confirm the day’s hours, especially if you are relying on the after-midnight window.
cards.short_summary: A Loop 1604 Taco Bell with drive-thru hours extending to 4 or 5 a.m., depending on the day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists 4 a.m. drive-thru closing Sunday–Wednesday and 5 a.m. Thursday–Saturday at 7323 N Loop 1604 W.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 7323 N Loop 1604 W
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 4 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 5 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Jack in the Box on Babcock
cards.subtitle: 2465 Babcock Rd · San Antonio
cards.notes: Use the Babcock location for its documented round-the-clock lobby and drive-thru availability, and review the live location page for changes.
cards.short_summary: A Babcock Road Jack in the Box with official locator hours showing 24-hour service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official locator lists both the drive-thru and lobby at 2465 Babcock Rd as operating from 4 a.m. to 4 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box at 2465 Babcock Rd
cards.access_notes: Official locator shows drive-thru and lobby hours of 4 a.m.–4 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Velvet Taco at The Rim
cards.subtitle: 5515 N Loop 1604 W #105 · San Antonio
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday evening stop and arrive before the documented 11 p.m. close; weekday service ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: A The Rim taco restaurant with official Friday and Saturday hours through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Velvet Taco’s official The Rim location page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 10:30 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday–Saturday hours until 11 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday service ends at 10 p.m.
